question: I'm 57 and have contributed for 20 years. Can I stop working and get my pension now?
reference_answer: Yes, early retirement is allowed from 55 if you stop working, and 240 months is above the 180-month minimum.

question: My wife delivered last month. She has contributed for 2 years only. Does she qualify for maternity benefit?
reference_answer: No. Maternity benefit needs at least 36 months of contributions; 24 months is not enough.

question: What percentage of salary does the employer pay?
reference_answer: The employer pays 10% of the gross monthly wage; the employee pays another 10%, 20% in total.

question: If my gross salary is TZS 1,200,000, what is the total monthly contribution?
reference_answer: TZS 240,000 (20%): TZS 120,000 from the employer and TZS 120,000 from the employee.

question: I was made redundant after 3 years of work and I am 40. What benefit can I get and for how long?
reference_answer: Unemployment benefit of 33.3% of the average monthly wage of the last 6 months, for up to 6 months, if you claim within 90 days.

question: I resigned to start my own business. Can I get unemployment benefit?
reference_answer: No, voluntary resignation does not qualify. You can join as a voluntary member instead.

question: A worker broke his leg in the factory. Should he claim from the Fund?
reference_answer: No, work injuries are compensated by the Workers Compensation Fund (WCF).

question: How much will the family receive towards funeral costs?
reference_answer: A funeral grant of TZS 500,000 to the person who paid for the funeral.

question: Within how many days should a complete claim be paid?
reference_answer: Within 30 days of receiving and verifying all documents.

question: What is the lowest monthly pension the Fund pays?
reference_answer: TZS 100,000 per month.

question: My grandfather has not verified for 14 months. Has his pension been cancelled?
reference_answer: No, it is suspended, not cancelled. It resumes, with arrears, once he verifies.

question: Can an agent receive my benefit on my behalf if I sign a letter?
reference_answer: No. Benefits are only paid into an account in the member's or verified dependant's own name.

question: A member died leaving a wife and three children. How is the survivors' pension split?
reference_answer: The wife receives 40% and the three children share 60% equally (20% each).

question: What is the annual pension for 300 contribution months and APE of TZS 12,000,000?
reference_answer: 300 ÷ 580 × 12,000,000 = about TZS 6,206,897 a year (about TZS 517,241 a month before commutation).

question: How long do I have to appeal a decision on my benefit?
reference_answer: 60 days from the decision.

question: I have 150 months of contributions and I am retiring at 60. What will I get?
reference_answer: An old age grant (a single payment of total contributions plus interest), because 150 is below the 180 months needed for a pension.

question: Can I update my bank account through the call centre?
reference_answer: No. Bank details can only be changed at a branch or on the member portal after identity verification.

question: What is the late payment penalty for contributions paid late in November 2025?
reference_answer: 2.5% of the unpaid contribution per month or part of a month, capped at 50% (circular FC/09/2025).

question: Kiasi gani cha mshahara kinakatwa kwa mfanyakazi?
reference_answer: Asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa mwezi; mwajiri analipa asilimia 10 nyingine.

question: Mama yangu ana miaka 78, anaweza kuhakikiwa nyumbani?
reference_answer: Ndiyo. Wastaafu wenye miaka 75 na zaidi wanaweza kuomba kutembelewa nyumbani kwa kupiga kituo cha huduma kwa wateja.

question: What is my current contribution balance?
reference_answer: The assistant cannot see personal records. Check the member portal, app, USSD or a branch.

question: Who won the football match yesterday?
reference_answer: This is outside the Fund's services; the assistant should politely decline.
